residencyRequirements.description: Either party must be domiciled in Nigeria at the time of filing (MCA s.2(1)). Alternatively, a wife who has been ordinarily resident in Nigeria for at least 3 years preceding the petition may file based on residency (MCA s.2(2)). Cross River State High Court has jurisdiction if either party resides within the state.

waitingPeriod.description: Decree Nisi becomes Decree Absolute after 3 months (MCA s.58). Cannot petition within 2 years of marriage without leave (MCA s.30).

twoYearBar.description: MCA s.30 — 2-year bar from date of marriage unless exceptional hardship or depravity.

noFault.name: 2-Year Separation with Consent
noFault.description: Lived apart 2+ years, respondent does not object.

fault.name: Failure to Comply with Restitution Order
fault.description: Respondent failed to comply with conjugal rights order.

fault.name: Presumption of Death (Absent 7 Years)
fault.description: Other party absent 7+ years, petitioner has no reason to believe them alive.

legalCitations.code: Matrimonial Causes Act 1970, Cap M7 LFN 2004

legalCitations.description: Welfare of the child — adopted by Cross River State

filingFees.notes: Filing fees vary by court registry.

decreeProcess.decreeNisi: Court grants Decree Nisi after hearing.
decreeProcess.decreeAbsolute: Decree Nisi becomes Decree Absolute after 3 months (MCA s.58).
